about: budget_alloc monotonicity over the FLATTENED caveat list of a delegation chain, root first (the append-only list verifyChain builds): every budget_alloc.limit must be a finite number >= 0 and never greater than the previous budget_alloc limit; the first problem in list order decides. The input is `caveats`; a verifier reproduces `expect` ({ok} or {ok:false, reason}) byte for byte. The reason names the index in the flattened list. Non-finite limits (NaN, Infinity) cannot be written in JSON: a verifier must also refuse them as malformed. Generated by scripts/gen-conformance-hardening.mjs; the TypeScript reference (allocationsMonotone) is proved against every case by src/hardening-vectors.test.ts.
